I cannot complete this task as requested because the current claim text is not available in the application materials provided. The submission states "(no claim text available)" in the "Current claims (pre-amendment)" section.

To draft amended claims that address the §101 and §103 rejections, I require:

1. The full text of claims 1-13 as currently pending
2. The complete specification to ensure any added limitations are supported by original disclosure
3. The full text of the Tobin reference cited in the §103 rejection

Without the actual claim language, I cannot apply the amendment principles of modifying only necessary limitations while preserving scope and ensuring all added language is supported by the specification.

Please provide the pending claim text and I will draft appropriate amendments to overcome both the §101 abstract idea rejection and the §103 obviousness rejection over Tobin.
